description_en: This three-bayed Phalcāis located on the eastern side of the lane that leads to Cyasāl (north) from Khapiṁchẽ (south), and is attached to a house in its back. Bhairava is the principle deity of this Phalcāwhich is why it is called Bhailaḥ Cidhã Phalcā. A shrine dedicated to Bhairava can be found in front of the Phalcā.Bhailaḥ Cidhã Phalcā's original structure and its early 18th century columns have been well preserved. The main entrance to the house can be accessed by crossing through the Phalcā. The family of the house that the Phalcāis attached to were also the ones who commissioned it. A descendant of the donors transformed one bay of the Phalcāinto a small shop and built rooms on the first floor; in doing so, they removed its tiled roof.
description_ne: तीन वटा कवल भएको यस फल्चामा प्रयोग भएका काष्ठस्तम्भहरू लगभग १८ औँ शताब्दीको सुरुका जस्ता देखिन्छन् । यस फल्चाको अगाडि भैरवको सानो मन्दिर छ । भैरवकै नाम बाट यस फल्चालाई भिन्द्यः लाछि फल्चा भन्न थालिएको हो । घरको ढोकामा पुग्न फल्चा हुँदै जानुपर्छ । फल्चाको पछाडि भएको घरका धनीले नै फल्चा बनाएर दान गरेका हुन् । तर पछि, दाताका सन्तति कान्छा महर्जनले यो फल्चा व्यक्तिगत बनाए । पहिला उनले फल्चाको एउटा कवलमा सानो पसल राख्न सुरु गरे । पछि उनले फल्चाको पहिलो तलामा टायलको छानो हटाएर कोठा बनाए ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
